regions.region: page 7 upper two-column continuation of Conclusions
regions.finding: The prose completes the low-temperature EPR/hydrostannation conclusions and links to the existing EPR and general-mechanism records; it introduces no new current-paper preparation or quantitative radical concentration.

regions.region: page 7 middle Scheme 9, all six arrows and citations
regions.finding: Recorded six distinct cited/past alkene hydrostannations with every printed hydride/initiator loading, medium, atmosphere, temperature, time, illumination, and yield. They are literature_example records, not current-paper experiments. The Manaviazar/Hale arrow's unpublished-versus-previously-disclosed wording is retained as unresolved.

regions.region: page 7 lower Experimental details and General information opening
regions.finding: Classified dry-solvent/N2 handling statements as general methods. They contextualize the procedures beginning on page 8 but do not constitute a reaction record.

unresolved: Scheme 9 does not provide absolute charges, workups, purification details, isolated masses, or yield bases for the cited experiments.
The Manaviazar/Hale Scheme 9 arrow is labelled unpublished, while reference 30b says the result was previously published in a review.

regions.finding: Captured the general chromatography/NMR context and added the printed EPR instrument, frequency, power, modulation, calibration, and tube parameters to the existing low-temperature EPR series; no sample-specific preparation was inferred.
Enriched the existing 1→2 record with the 20 mL first water wash, three 20 mL CH2Cl2 extractions, and 50 mL final water wash while retaining the full 5 min/24 h sequence and 79% isolated yield.
Enriched the existing 2→3 record with the 20 mL and 80 mL Et2O additions and two 20 mL extractions. The scheme 2 h versus procedure 3.5 h conflict remains explicit.

regions.region: page 8 bottom start of alkyne 4 procedure
regions.finding: Linked the aldehyde/K2CO3/Ohira–Bestmann charges and the 15 min addition to the existing 3→4 record; the procedure continues on page 9.

unresolved: General EPR parameters do not supply sample-specific absolute charges, concentrations, or acquisition settings for each spectrum.
Several drying-agent and chromatography fraction quantities remain unreported.

regions.region: page 9 upper completion of alkyne 4 procedure
regions.finding: Enriched the existing 3→4 record with 80 mL CH2Cl2/50 mL water dilution and three 30 mL CH2Cl2 extractions; the 19 h scheme versus 21 h procedure conflict remains explicit.

Enriched the existing 4→5 record with the 40 mL Et2O quench/dilution and two 40 mL extractions while preserving the ordered 2 h activation, 15 min 60 °C preheat, and 25 h post-formaldehyde hold. The scheme/procedure time conflict remains explicit.

regions.region: page 9 lower Bu3SnH/PhMe hydrostannation procedure and product-21 data
regions.finding: Linked the full 5/Bu3SnH/Et3B/air/PhMe preparation, 24 h room-temperature hold, chromatography, 130 mg product mass, and 43% isolated yield to the existing Scheme 5 record; spectroscopy was treated as characterization, not a duplicate reaction.

unresolved: Drying-agent/chromatography fraction amounts and the amount of unreacted 5 are not reported.
The scheme/procedure duration conflicts for 3→4 and 4→5 remain unresolved.

regions.finding: Enriched the existing aqueous hydrostannation with the 50 mL water wash and retained the ordered warm-up, 1 h first Et3B stage, second Et3B charge, and 1.5 h second stage. The subsection heading says rt, whereas the scheme/procedure say 72 °C; both source statements are preserved.

regions.region: page 10 middle Ph3SnH/PhMe procedure and separation
regions.finding: Linked the full glove-bag/N2 charge, 10 s Et3B addition, 3 h 10 min hold, two-stage flash purification, repeated preparative-TLC analytical separation, 0.43 g combined mass, 67% combined yield, and 1.39:1 23/24 ratio to the existing record. The page-3 3.25 h versus page-10 3 h 10 min conflict remains explicit.

regions.region: page 10 lower spectral data for 23 and 24
regions.finding: Treated the printed NMR data as characterization of the existing 23/24 products, not separate preparations; structure/geometry assignment evidence continues on pages 11–12.

unresolved: Aqueous-reaction temperature conflict: heading says rt, detailed procedure and scheme say 72 °C.
Individual isolated masses/yields of 23 and 24 and the analytical basis of their 1.39:1 ratio are not reported.

regions.region: page 11 upper continuation of product-24 spectral data
regions.finding: Linked the remaining 13C NMR/tin-coupling data to the existing Ph3SnH experiment; no new reaction operation or yield occurs.

Captured high-field 1H/13C NMR, HSQC, proton count, and proposed intermolecular O–Sn association as characterization/interpretation of product 23, not a second preparation or machine structure verification.
Linked DEPT-135, HMBC, chemical-shift, and Sn–C coupling arguments to the existing product-24 assignment; the discussion continues on page 12.

unresolved: Spectroscopic interpretation supports the authors' assignments but does not verify a machine structure encoding.
No individual preparation yield or mass for purified 23 or 24 is provided.

regions.region: page 12 upper continuation of product-24 NMR assignment
regions.finding: Linked the H(4)-Sn coupling of approximately 166.8 Hz, COSY connectivity, proton counts, hydroxyl observations, and aromatic-carbon count to the existing (Z)-24 characterization. These data do not define a new reaction.

regions.region: page 12 middle Data availability, Conflicts, and Acknowledgements
regions.finding: Administrative statements only. Although the article points to ESI, workspace Supporting Information association remains unestablished and no SI fact was imported.
Bibliography and prior literature only; cited external papers were not expanded into additional current-paper experiment records.

unresolved: No individual isolated mass/yield is supplied for separated 23 or 24.
The article's ESI statement does not establish a workspace SI association.
Referenced external experiments were not re-extracted as current-paper records.
